capability.summary: Search Crossref scholarly works and return three metadata records
capability.description: Queries Crossref's fixed works endpoint with one free-text query and rows=3, returning DOI and publication metadata in the shared JSON envelope. It is scholarly metadata discovery, not full-text retrieval or peer-review assessment.
capability.problem_space: Crossref bibliographic work discovery by query; not full-text academic search, citation-quality judgment, article download, or clinical-trial lookup.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one Crossref query at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope containing Crossref message metadata with up to three items, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: one free-text scholarly title, author, DOI fragment, or topic query
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.crossref.org/works with query=<argument> and rows=3
no filter, cursor, page, sort, select, mailto, full-text, or caller-selected rows input; all CLI arguments after position 1 are ignored
rows=3 is an API request limit; wrapper does not locally parse, paginate, or truncate the Crossref message
missing input is not validated and the query parameter is omitted
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing up to three Crossref scholarly work metadata records and DOI fields, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: search scholarly works by title or topic
find DOI and Crossref publication metadata
negative_intents: search clinical trials or judge article quality
